cards.title: Don't Buy Grand Theft Auto VI for Your Child
cards.body: Rockstar Games' latest game is rated 18 and stuffed with explicit sex, drugs, and violence. It's the most explicit game the reviewer has played and absolutely not suitable for kids.

cards.title: Adult Son Moving Back Home? Here's What to Expect
cards.body: Many graduates are returning to the nest due to economic pressures. Parents need to adjust expectations as their mothering skills and house dynamics shift.

cards.title: Spot Online Stalking Warning Signs in Your Child
cards.body: Cases of online stalking targeting young people are rising. Parents should watch for fake profiles and unwanted contact as key warning signs.

cards.title: Teen Gamer and Mom Help FBI Rescue Missing Girl
cards.body: A 16-year-old met a kidnapped girl while playing online games and alerted his mother. Together they helped the FBI locate and rescue her.

cards.title: Talk to Kids About Holiday Financial Challenges
cards.body: Tough economic times can strain holiday traditions and gift-giving. Parents should have honest conversations with children about budget constraints.

cards.title: Why Being Home Makes You Feel Like a Teenager
cards.body: Old family patterns resurface during holidays, making adults feel younger than they are. Personality science explains why and offers strategies to manage it.
